title: The health snapshot reports 7/7 ok while structurally unable to see the failure that happened
note: MEASURED 2026-09-22T05:30Z from /api/bot/health/latest (snapshot ts 05:16:31Z): status ok, summary `7/7 checks ok`, action_required false. The seven checks are service, git_drift, git_fetch, tick, accounts_api, db, disk. The accounts_api check's OWN detail string reads: `all 8 recorded broker-API accounts ok (1 manual-bridge skipped: breakout_1; 2 dry/shelved skipped: ib_live, oanda_practice)`. [!] breakout_1 IS THE FUNDED PROP ACCOUNT THAT RECEIVED ZERO TICKETS FOR THREE WEEKS (row E16, measured 21 of 21). The account check EXCLUDES it by construction -- it is the one account skipped -- and no check among the seven asks whether signals, intents or tickets are still being PRODUCED. The surface the operator looks at was green throughout the failure and would be green through the next one. [!] CROSS-CHECKED against /api/bot/accounts/balances: breakout_1 balance null, open_positions null, api_ok false. The DATA is honest (null, not 0 -- the repo's own render rule followed correctly). The defect is that nothing GRADES it: an account permanently api_ok:false is indistinguishable from one that just went dark. [!] COMPLEMENTS E18, does not duplicate it. E18 builds the missing detector (intents produced vs tickets received). This row is narrower and cheaper: the EXISTING all-clear counts a structurally-skipped account toward 7/7. [!] PROPOSED FIX (Tier-1, reporting only, no runtime path): (a) report skipped accounts as a distinct state in the summary line -- `7/7 ok, 3 accounts NOT CHECKED` rather than folding them into ok; (b) add a per-routed-account last-ticket-age check, which is the check whose absence E16 measured. [!] E18 BOUNDARY, ARGUED ON THE ROW AS ASKED -- AND THE ANSWER IS THAT E22 IS **BOTH** HALVES SPLIT, NOT ONE CHOICE. The row proposed two fixes and they belong to different owners. (a) 'report skipped accounts as a distinct state' IS E22's OWN and has nothing to do with E18: it is a collapsed state in the REPORTING arithmetic -- `7/7 checks ok` counted an exclusion as a pass -- and it is wrong independently of whether any detector ever exists. BUILT HERE. (b) 'add a per-routed-account last-ticket-age check' IS E18's SIGNAL and is NOT built here: putting it in the snapshot writer would be exactly the second, drifting implementation this row was told not to become. When E18 lands it reports its own verdict; the snapshot keeps saying only what was and was not EXAMINED. [!] SO THE TWO ROWS COMPOSE RATHER THAN OVERLAP: E18 answers 'is that account still being FED?' (a detector that must exist and does not). E22 answers 'does the all-clear admit it did not LOOK?' (an arithmetic bug in a surface that already exists). Neither substitutes. [!] BUILT, Tier-2, reporting-only: scripts/write_health_snapshot.py::build_payload now emits a top-level `not_checked: {accounts[], count, by_check{}}` and appends `; N account(s) NOT CHECKED: <names>` to the summary line. Keyed on each check's own `ctx` lists (skipped / shelved / no_data), NEVER parsed out of the `detail` prose -- the prose is a claim about the check, the ctx is the check's record of what it did. The accounts_api check already emitted all three, so no producer change was needed. [!] `no_data` IS INCLUDED DELIBERATELY AND IS THE DANGEROUS MEMBER, which the row did not name: the accounts_api check subtracts it from its OWN headline (`all {total - len(no_data)} ... ok`), so a declared-live account WITH a broker API whose reading never arrived passes exactly as quietly as a manual bridge that was never eligible. That is 'we could not look' wearing 'ok', the same collapse one level down. [!] ⚠️ WHAT WAS DELIBERATELY NOT DONE, AND WHY, so a later change does not make it quietly: `status` and `action_required` ARE UNMOVED. A manual bridge is skipped on EVERY snapshot for its whole life, so grading the exclusion `watch` would put one permanent condition on every snapshot forever -- the desensitised alarm the canonical rules already call a P1 (BL-20260823-TARGET-NAKED-COOLDOWN put ONE condition on 53.7% of the operator's ERROR+ feed by that exact mechanism), and the same refusal soak_alarm's `accruing` state makes. A permanent amber is not a detector. There is a test asserting the refusal so it cannot be reversed silently. THE ROW'S BAR IS STILL MET: `7/7 ok` is no longer SAYABLE alone -- the summary string itself now carries the named excluded accounts, and the summary is the field /api/bot/health/latest serves and that E22 measured. [!] VALIDATION: 82 tests pass locally (tests/test_write_health_snapshot.py 14, incl. 5 new, plus test_health.py and test_exit_loop_health.py). The five new ones assert the exact 2026-09-22 snapshot shape (7/7 with breakout_1 + ib_live + oanda_practice NAMED, not merely counted), the `no_data` case, the dedup/union across checks, the unmoved status, and a POSITIVE CONTROL FOR THE NEGATIVE -- `count: 0` with the field PRESENT is a real measurement ('every account was examined') and is distinguishable from a check that emitted no ctx at all, which is visible by its absence from `by_check`. ⚠️ NOT run locally: the router test (tests/test_diag_exit_loop_health_reachable.py) -- fastapi is not installed in this sandbox, so that one is CI's to run; said rather than claimed. [!] STATE: NOT `done` and not observable from here. This writer runs ON the live VM under ict-health-snapshot.timer, so merged != deployed != observed. WHAT WOULD CLOSE IT: a /api/bot/health/latest read whose `summary` carries `account(s) NOT CHECKED` and whose `not_checked.accounts` names breakout_1 -- one diag pull after the next deploy. [!] MANAGER 2026-09-22: MERGED as b6e87b2b. NOT deployed, NOT observed. CLOSING THIS ROW MEANS reading /api/bot/health/latest and seeing breakout_1 reported as a GRADED skip instead of folded into `7/7 checks ok` -- i.e. the summary distinguishing `we did not look` from `we looked and found nothing` for that account. DONE — VERIFIED 2026-09-25T13:22Z via GET /api/bot/health/latest: summary reads "8/8 checks ok; 3 account(s) NOT CHECKED: breakout_1, ib_live, oanda_practice" and not_checked.accounts names breakout_1 explicitly. The all-clear no longer folds the structurally-skipped account into 7/7 (now 8/8 with the exclusion named). Closing condition met verbatim.
